caseName: Hamilton v. Superior Court of California ex rel. Marin County
caseNameFull: HAMILTON, alias HAYDEN v. SUPERIOR COURT OF CALIFORNIA, IN AND FOR MARIN COUNTY
attorneys: Appellant pro se., Richard Gladstein and Norman Leonard for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
